epi-curve.authority: Propagated (person-to-person) outbreak: successive peaks rise (28 then 35), peak week 7 with 35 cases, total 176 cases over 12 weeks.

normal-dist.authority: Normal curve: mean = median = mode = 2800 g; low birth weight (<2500 g) is 25.2% of births (z = -0.67).

skewed-dist.authority: Right (positive) skew with a long right tail: mean (5.05 days) > median (5 days) > mode (4 days); median is the preferred average.

forest-plot.authority: Pooled odds ratio 0.78 (95% CI 0.68-0.89) favours zinc; Verma 2022 and Khan 2023 cross the null (OR 1.0) so are individually non-significant.

funnel-plot.authority: Asymmetric funnel with a gap at the bottom right (small imprecise studies with null or negative effects are missing): publication bias suspected.

km-survival.authority: Curves separate after 4 months and stay apart: 24-month survival 76% (new regimen) vs 50% (standard); ticks mark censored patients.

roc-curve.authority: AUC 0.83 (good test; 1.0 is perfect, 0.5 is useless); the curve bows to the top-left and the marked operating point gives sensitivity 63% at 88% specificity.

numbers.classes: Total 26-29 = Upper (I); 16-25 = Upper middle (II); 11-15 = Lower middle (III); 5-10 = Upper lower (IV); <5 = Lower (V).

kuppuswamy.authority: Kuppuswamy score = education (1-7) + occupation (1-10) + income (1-12); total 26-29 Upper (I), 16-25 Upper middle (II), 11-15 Lower middle (III), 5-10 Upper lower (IV), below 5 Lower (V).

bmi-scale.authority: WHO classes: <18.5 underweight, 18.5-24.9 normal, 25-29.9 overweight (pre-obese), >=30 obese; the plotted adult at BMI 27.3 is overweight.

demo-pyramid.authority: Expansive pyramid with a broad base (high birth rate): 0-14 years are 294,000 of 882,000; young + old dependency ratio 58.9 per 100 working-age.

cold-chain.authority: Cold chain keeps vaccines at +2C to +8C from state store (walk-in cooler) to session site (vaccine carrier); freeze-sensitive DPT/HepB must never freeze.
